title: 第151章 积分结算
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

夜晚的试炼场有种异常的热闹。

李知出现在空荡荡的擂台上时，还看到凤傲天和赫纳等鬣狗兽人围坐在一片小小的沼泽边，正在大声说笑着。

她一出现，面对这边的赫冬就看到了。

赫冬起身道：“老板！”

李知被金色光芒托着落在地上，被众多试炼者注视着，走到她们之间，在赫纳和赫冬之间坐下。

“没想到晚上的试炼场这么热闹。”

叫我凤傲天：“晚上试炼区会出现一些奇怪的生物，赫冬说它们是残源，这些残源会吞噬试炼者的生命力，时间久了还可能损失属性点，所以大家晚上都不出去。”

李知好奇：“那你们怎么不回去？”

凤傲天和赫纳是可以自由传送的。

赫纳：“我的族人在这里。”

叫我凤傲天：“这不是最后一个晚上了吗？12点就结算奖励了，我肯定要等着，看看有什么好东西。”

见李知好奇地目光扫向周围三两聚集的试炼者。

赫冬解释道：“赛季末普通试炼者退出试炼区就要扣除积分，试炼者们就自发在聚集在试炼场，并且约定除了擂台赛外，试炼区内的比赛时间只到太阳落山之前，不然即使拿到了赛季末的奖励，和被外面的残源吸走的属性点比起来，也还是亏了。”

李知：“原来如此。”

但她依旧好奇，“你们见过外面的残源吗？什么模样？知道它们是怎么出现的吗？”

赫冬摇头：“所有的试炼区夜晚都有残源出现，有人猜测是试炼区包含一部分天启族的力量，导致死去的试炼者的本源得以残留，不过就算是在外面，夜晚也比白天危险，总会有怪物袭击，大家已经习惯晚上聚集在一起保持警惕了。”

叫我凤傲天深有同感：“特别跟着极寒一起来的嗜血之灵，杀倒是不难杀，但是长得太恶心，我每次杀完都觉得清理好久。”

李知想起了追着夜翼走的罗红和嗜血魔灵。

她的飞舟升级飞舰就是为了对付嗜血魔灵，却没想到飞舟停泊希维尔这边升级，反而隔绝了嗜血魔灵的攻击。

但李知不认为罗红这次放过了她，下次她还会有一样的好运。

她找到影的聊天框：[罗红和夜翼族有什么恩怨？]

这次影没有马上回。

李知也不着急，她支着下巴坐在一群女孩子之间，听她们聊天。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There was an unusual liveliness in the trial ground at night.

When Li Zhi appeared on the empty arena, he saw Feng Aotian, Hena and other hyena orcs sitting around a small swamp, talking and laughing loudly.

As soon as she appeared, He Dong, who was facing here, saw her.

He Dong stood up and said: "Boss!"

Li Zhi was carried by the golden light and landed on the ground. He was watched by many trialists. He walked between them and sat down between Hena and Hedong.

"I didn't expect the trial field to be so lively at night."

Call me Feng Aotian: "Some strange creatures will appear in the trial area at night. He Dong said that they are residual sources. These residual sources will swallow up the vitality of the trialists and may lose attribute points over time, so everyone does not go out at night."

Li Zhi was curious: "Then why don't you go back?"

Feng Aotian and Hena can teleport freely.

Henner: "My people are here."

Call me Feng Aotian: "Isn't this the last night? The rewards will be settled at 12 o'clock. I will definitely wait to see what good things there are."

Li Zhi glanced curiously at the testers gathered around him.

He Dong explained: "At the end of the season, ordinary trialists will have their points deducted when they leave the trial area. The trialists spontaneously gathered in the trial area and agreed that except for the arena competition, the competition time in the trial area will only be before the sun sets. Otherwise, even if you get the end-of-season reward, you will still lose money compared with the attribute points that are sucked away by the residual sources outside."

Li Zhi: "That's it."

But she was still curious, "Have you seen the remnants outside? What do they look like? Do you know how they appeared?"

He Dong shook his head: "Remnants appear in all trial areas at night. Some people speculate that the trial area contains part of the power of the Apocalypse clan, which causes the origins of the dead trialists to remain. However, even outside, the night is more dangerous than the day. There will always be monster attacks. Everyone is used to gathering together at night to stay vigilant."

Call me Feng Aotian and I feel the same way: "Especially the bloodthirsty spirits that come with the extreme cold are not difficult to kill, but they look so disgusting that it takes me a long time to clean them up every time I kill them."

Li Zhi thought of Luo Hong and the bloodthirsty demon who were chasing Ye Yi.

Her airship was upgraded to deal with the bloodthirsty demons, but she did not expect that the airship docked at Sivir's side for the upgrade, which in turn blocked the bloodthirsty demons' attack.

But Li Zhi didn't think that if Luo Hong let her go this time, she would have the same good luck next time.

She found Ying's chat box: [What's the grudge between Luo Hong and the Nightwing clan?]

This time the movie didn't come back right away.

Li Zhi was not in a hurry. She sat with her chin propped up among a group of girls and listened to their chat.
